prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t one “best” AI video ad maker — the right tool depends on your goals (social vs. TV), need for realistic human presenters, budget, scale and workflow. Below are top options by use case to help you choose quickly.

Top picks (what they’re best at)
- Synthesia — Best for realistic AI presenters and multilingual spoken ads. Great for polished brand/explainer ads that need people-on-screen without filming.
- HeyGen / Colossyan / DeepBrain (similar category) — Alternatives to Synthesia; slightly different avatars, pricing and languages — good if you want variety or a lower cost option.
- InVideo — Best all‑around social ad creator: templates, easy timeline editing, stock assets and export presets for Facebook/Instagram/YouTube.
- Canva — Best for speed and brand consistency: templates, simple animation, brand kit, very approachable for non-designers.
- Pictory — Best for turning scripts/long content (webinars, blogs) into short ad videos; strong auto-captioning.
- Promo.com — Best if you want premade ad templates + big stock footage/music library for social ads.
- Shakr — Best for e-commerce and dynamic ad variations (scale many creatives for testing).
- Runway / Descript — Best for advanced generative editing, creative effects, and precise spoken-word editing (Descript’s Overdub is great for voice fixes).

How to choose
- Need realistic on-screen hosts or multi‑language voiceovers: choose Synthesia/HeyGen.
- Need lots of templates and fast social reels/stories: choose Canva, InVideo, Promo.
- Repurposing long content into short ads: choose Pictory.
- Running large-scale testing or dynamic product ads: choose Shakr or ad-optimization platforms.
- Tight budget / DIY editing: try CapCut or FlexClip for low-cost/free options.
- Want advanced generative effects or filmmaker-level editing: try Runway.

If you tell me:
- your budget (free/cheap/pro),
- the platform(s) you’ll run ads on (Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, TV),
- whether you need real human presenters or text-to-video,
I’ll recommend 1–2 best choices and a short setup workflow for your use case. Which is it?
